notes: Official CBP Form 301 'CUSTOMS BOND', 19 CFR Part 113, posted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (cbp.gov) 04/30/2024; the form face reads 'CBP Form 301 (04/24)'. OMB Approval No. 1651-0050, expiration 08/31/2025 — CBP's own page notes the OMB date is expired but the form is still valid for use and under OMB review for a new date.

114 fillable AcroForm widgets inventoried (the PDF field tree lists 117 entries; 3 are container nodes, not widgets). Checkbox-to-activity and limit-of-liability pairings verified by widget-rect proximity against the PDF's own text layer (e.g. code1/LimitofLiability1 sit on the '1 Importer or broker' row; activity 15/16/17 pair with LimitofLiability16/17/18).

The 'Name and Physical Address' widgets are ambiguous by name alone (nameaddress[0] vs namephysical[0]); page-1 rects place nameaddress[0] in the PRINCIPAL block (y~210-262) and namephysical[0] in the SURETY block (y~32-95) — verified against the extracted text positions.

Key-field scope only: page 1 bond terms (Section I), one Section II activity + limit of liability, principal identity, surety identity basics. Page 2 (co-principal, co-surety, Section III trade names) and the seal-declaration checkboxes are hand-completed by the filer/broker/surety.

Honest scope caveat: in practice continuous bonds are filed electronically via CBP's eBond/ACE process arranged by the importer's customs broker and surety; the paper Form 301 is the legacy path. The form definition's notices say this plainly and advise confirming with the broker/surety.

fields.reviewNote: Surety Reference Number, top of page 1 — optional.
Broker Filer Code, top of page 1 — optional; the customs broker's filer code.
'AFFIX SEAL or Check Box' — the filer's own declaration that they have a seal per 19 CFR 113.25. Completed by hand, never by SmartPR.
Principal's CBP Identification Number (importer of record number — for a company, its EIN) — from the form's importer_cbp_id answer, prefilled from the business EIN and correctable on the form.

PRINCIPAL 'Name and Physical Address (including legal description and state of incorporation)'. The canonical pass prints the business legal name; cbp301Values() overwrites it with name + physical address composed from the form answers (prefilled from the profile and correctable on the form) — direct answers take precedence by design.

SURETY 'Name and Physical Address (including legal description and state of incorporation)' — the surety's own block; SmartPR prints only what the applicant supplied (surety_name + surety_address), the surety completes the rest by hand.
Surety Number — the surety company's CBP-assigned number, supplied by the applicant when known.
'AFFIX SEAL or Check Box' — the filer's own declaration that they have a seal per 19 CFR 113.25. Completed by hand, never by SmartPR.
Surety's Agent ID Number — the surety's agent completes it.

CONTINUOUS BOND box, Section I — checked when the form's bond_type answer is 'continuous'.
Identification of transaction secured by this bond (entry number, seizure number, etc.) — single-transaction bonds only.
Execution Date, top right of page 1 — written from the form's execution_date answer via cbp301Values().
Transaction Date — single-transaction bonds only.
Port Code — single-transaction bonds only.
